name: Margin
description: A six-page design journal with a large serif masthead, a varied editorial front page, three complete original essays, and a reading-focused archive.

notes.layout: serif masthead, lead story beside secondary essays, editorial letter, issue index, readable article pages
notes.motion: restrained image hover and reduced-motion-aware anchor navigation
notes.interaction: search and filter essays, save a reading list, switch reading modes, adjust article text size, print essays
notes.provenance: Original six-page editorial concept with its own composition, writing, and reading controls. Two licensed photographs and one existing generated illustration are credited; no reference code or assets included.
